title: fix(core): ADR-0079 — one record-title resolver, stop rendering "Untitled"
body:
**ADR-0079 Phase 1 (objectui side).** An object whose records carry their name in a non-`name` field (e.g. `activity_name`) and that declares no title field rendered **"Untitled"** on gallery cards, calendar pills, lookup chips, related-lists, breadcrumbs and search — because ~6 divergent resolvers each used a different hard-coded field list and none read the object's `displayNameField`.

## What
- One shared `getRecordDisplayName` in `@object-ui/core` (`utils/record-title.ts`). Precedence: explicit view `titleField` → `titleFormat` → `displayNameField` → **type-aware derivation** (name-ish exact > `*_name`/`*_title` affix > first text-eligible field; excludes date/number/select/lookup/…) → name-ish record keys → `Record #<id>` floor (**never bare "Untitled"** for an id-bearing record).
- Re-points all 6 sites: app-shell, fields/LookupField, plugin-list/calendar/kanban/gantt, plugin-detail, react/useRecordSearch. Kills the gallery `?? 'name'` hardcode. Net **−196 lines**.
- **2nd commit (caught by live browser testing, not unit tests):** the resolver now also scans the *record's own keys* for the `*_name`/`*_title` affix — so an `activity_name` label resolves even when the caller's `objectDef` didn't drive type-aware derivation. +4 tests reproducing the exact gallery failure.

## Verification
- `@object-ui/core` record-title: **56/56** green.
- Live browser (local rig): the activity gallery renders **夏日城市骑行夜 / 西湖晨跑团 / …** instead of "Untitled".

Uses today's `displayNameField` (no framework dep). `titleFormat` kept working; full retirement + the `nameField` rename are later cross-repo phases (see framework ADR-0079 work).
